name: Pluxo Blueprint
author: pluxo

sections.description:
Pluxo Blueprint is a WordPress plugin that helps you generate a clear PDF snapshot of your site documentation, including installed plugins, active theme information, users and roles, detected page builders, and high-level tracking signals.

It also allows you to export your plugin inventory to CSV, JSON, or Markdown, making it easy to reuse the data for documentation or development workflows in tools like Confluence, Notion, or OneNote.

Pluxo Blueprint runs entirely inside your WordPress installation and does not rely on external services or tracking.

Features

  • Generate a one-click PDF snapshot of your WordPress site documentation
  • Includes site information such as:
    • Installed plugins
    • Active theme
    • Users and roles
    • Detected page builders
    • High-level tracking signals
  • View a detailed table of installed plugins in the WordPress admin
  • Choose which plugin data columns to include in exports
  • Export plugin inventory to:
    • CSV
    • JSON
    • Markdown (ideal for Notion, Confluence, GitHub, etc.)
  • No external services or tracking
  • All data stays inside your WordPress installation
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Pluxo → Blueprint
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send data externally?

No. All data stays inside your WordPress installation.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. Pluxo Blueprint is free and fully functional.

Does the plugin require external libraries?

The plugin bundles all required libraries internally and does not rely on external services.
